item.title: Pool cleaners seen in Nancy Guthrie’s yard amid desperate search
item.description: Pool cleaners were reportedly accompanied by authorities on Friday as they worked in Nancy Guthrie's backyard amid the desperate search for the missing woman.

item.title: Bus lane, bike lane projects killed by Adams coming back under Mamdani
item.description: The projects include offset bus lanes on Fordham Road in the Bronx, a two-way protected bike lane on a redesigned Ashland Place in Brooklyn, bike lanes along Brooklyn and Kingston Avenues, and a bike lane network in Flatbush and Midwood.

item.title: Coyne Schofield scores 2 goals as US routs Italy 6-0 to advance to Olympic women’s hockey semifinals
item.description: Top-seeded United States routed Olympic host Italy 6-0 in a lopsided, festive and sometimes chippy women’s hockey quarterfinal at the Milan Cortina Games on Friday night.

item.title: Ring cancels controversial doorbell camera collaboration with Flock Safety
item.description: Ring has canceled its plans to partner with Flock Safety on a doorbell camera system that critics have labeled a privacy concern.

item.title: DHS to spend $38B turning warehouses into ICE detention centers
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is planning to spend $38.3 billion turning warehouses into immigrant detention centers, documents show.

item.title: Wendy’s to close hundreds of locations by the summer
item.description: Wendy's plans to close hundreds of its U.S. eateries by the middle of 2026. The fast food chain hopes low pricing will bring back consumers.

item.title: FDNY rescues boy, 11, who fell through ice into frigid Queens pond
item.description: The boy plummeted into the freezing waters at Springfield Park near Springfield Blvd. and 146th Ave. just before 3 p.m., according to police.

item.title: Weather alerts issued for NYC as wind-chill feel plunges into the 20s
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a hazardous weather advisory for New York City in anticipation of frigid wind chills amid scattered snow showers expected Friday night into Saturday morning.
